items.title: Supply chain attack on arrayref
items.blurb: What happened On 2026-08-20 at 7:15 UTC we got a report that the proc-macro1 crate was malicious. The Rust Security Response Team verified this to be the case: the crate had a build script that was downloading a malicious payload.

items.title: Enabling the next-generation trait solver on nightly
items.blurb: After nearly 4 years of active development, the next-generation trait solver is close to stabilization. We are enabling it by default on nightly to surface any remaining issues and plan to stabilize it in the next months.

items.title: Announcing Rust 1.98.0
items.blurb: The Rust team is happy to announce a new version of Rust, 1.98.0. Rust is a programming language empowering everyone to build reliable and efficient software.

items.title: Astro Introduces Sätteri: a Rust-Powered Markdown and Mdx Processor with up to 60% Faster Builds
items.blurb: Sätteri is a high-performance Markdown and MDX processor developed by the Astro team. Built in Rust, it enhances build speeds by up to 61% for Astro 7.0.
